"""
========
timer.py
========

:summary:
    Simplifies recording of update times in simulations.
    This module contains timers used for recording the times between
    measurements and announcing when new measurement is to be taken.
    Since this task is often performed by each measurement (and GPS) object,
    the routine code has been refracted into a simple standalone class. Doing
    this has the added benefit of allowing times to be saved between
    simulation partitions.

:author:
    Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk

:version:
    1.0.0 - First full implementation of class.
"""




[docs]
class UpdateTimer:
    """
    Used for recording and announcing update times for measurements.
    This simple counts the time and records the indices covering the range of
    measurements to be involved. This information can then be used to extract
    the relevant indices of data from the waypoint information.
    """

    def __init__(self, freq: float):

        # Obtain the timestep for updates
        self.__update_timestep = 1 / freq

        # Calculate the time for the next measurement.
        self.__next_update_time = self.__update_timestep



[docs]
    def is_ready(self, clock_time: float) -> bool:
        """
        Announces if enough time has elapsed for a measurement to be ready.
        This method returns True if it is time for a measurement to be
        produced.

        :param clock_time: The current believed simulation time (in seconds).
        :type clock_time: float

        :return: Returns true if it is time to take a measurement.
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return clock_time >= self.__next_update_time



    def get_weightings(self, time_prev, time_now):
        weight1 = (self.__next_update_time - time_prev) / (
                time_now - time_prev)
        return weight1, 1 - weight1

    def increment_timer(self):
        self.__next_update_time += self.__update_timestep
